amends.rule: the pre-registration is not edited. This amendment records one measured fact about how the harness applies a limit, and what that fact means for the sample the pass actually scored.

finding.what_was_registered: the subset registration says the intermediate pass caps MMLU at 2,000 items and that this makes the knowledge mean an estimate on 2,000 of 14,042 items.
finding.what_the_harness_did: MMLU is a 57-subject group task and the harness applies `limit` per subtask, not per group. Passing `mmlu=2000` therefore selected min(2000, n_subject) for every subject. Every subject has fewer than 2,000 items, so the effective sample is all 14,042 items.

measured_evidence.reading: a true 2,000-item run would be about one seventh of the anchor's full-MMLU wall time; 654 s against 639 s is the full set

finding.correction: the pre-registration's `limits_derived_from`-style statement that MMLU is capped at 2,000 is wrong in effect. The pass scored the full 14,042-item MMLU, exactly as the anchor pre-registration does. The receipt's `pre_registered.limit = 2000` and `limit_from_limit_map = true` record the command that was issued; `n_samples.sample_len = 14042` records what was actually scored, and the receipt is read that way.

unchanged: every few-shot count, batch size, seed, bootstrap iteration and greedy-decoding setting
the arms, checkpoints and held-out comparison
what_changes_and_what_does_not.changed_in_reading_only: the knowledge family mean is on the full MMLU, not a 2,000-item subset. It is therefore on the same basis as the anchor's 37.90 knowledge mean and the registered 42.01 knowledge threshold. The 42.01 / 39.27 thresholds are still not evaluated as a win by this intermediate pass, because the mechanism arms are at 2,000,000 tokens and there is no full-distillation arm.
what_changes_and_what_does_not.no_rerun: no arm is re-run. The effective sample was already the full set for every arm, and every arm uses the same command.

what_this_amendment_does_not_establish: that the 2M-token arms reach the WS19 thresholds: the family means are reported as an intermediate signal, not a win
that a limit passed to a group task is a total limit: the measured fact is the opposite for this harness
that the pre-registration was wrong about anything except the effective MMLU sample
